We are migrating Iron Command Forge (ICF) into its dedicated standalone repository at C:\dev\icf (sorensencc-dotcom/icf).
Phase 1: ICF Code & Wiki Audit has just completed.

Please review the Phase 1 audit and migration plan:
1. Preflight status and diagnosis on C:\dev\icf:
   - Root manifest missing (caused verify-repo-context.ps1 to fail). Remediation: Add root package.json linking npm workspaces for ./reporting and ./dashboard.
2. Component audit matrix:
   - Reporting core in C:\dev\icf\reporting (83 passing unit/contract tests).
   - Web dashboard in C:\dev\kb-sync\modules\wiki\dashboard.html & _ds (150KB SPA + Cast Iron Charlie design system).
   - Server & API gateway in C:\dev\kb-sync\server.mjs & LocalFileAdapterTransport.mjs.
   - Daemon watchdog in C:\dev\kb-sync\scripts\ensure-dashboard-server.ps1 & register-dashboard-server-task.ps1.
3. Standalone repository directory structure for C:\dev\icf:
   - Root: package.json, README.md, docs/
   - src/: server.mjs, adapters/
   - dashboard/: index.html, support.js, _ds/
   - reporting/: schema/, src/, test/, weekly-reporting-dashboard.mjs
   - scripts/: ensure-dashboard-server.ps1, register-dashboard-server-task.ps1
4. Architecture specification & Cathryn Lavery diagram:
   - C:\dev\icf\docs\icf-architecture-diagram.html (warm editorial palette: #f2ece2, #2c2420, #5c5349, #c4501a, Playfair Display, Barlow Condensed, Geist Mono).
   - Rendered C:\dev\icf\docs\icf-architecture-diagram.png.
   - Concept note in C:\dev\kb-sync\obsidian\vault\wiki\concepts\iron-command-forge.md with enclosed Mermaid source.

Give your unvarnished, high-rigor engineering review:
